detailed_descriptions.en: Experience a world beyond imagination! Embark on the most exciting adventure imaginable with the return of one the best role-playing series of all time. Explore treacherous wilderness, perilous dungeons and fascinating towns - all in the same continuous 3D map. Cast over 45 different spells, drink potions and perform rituals with the most innovative magic system ever experienced in a fantasy game. Immerse yourself in a Fantasy Role-Playing Masterpiece with real life physics and authentic character interaction with fully digitized speech. Featuring the legendary Ultima System of Virtues where moral fiber is more powerful than physical might. Find out if you have what it takes to be the ultimate hero.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Experience a world beyond imagination!

Embark on the most exciting adventure imaginable with the return of one the best role-playing series of all time. Explore treacherous wilderness, perilous dungeons and fascinating towns - all in the same continuous 3D map.

  • Cast over 45 different spells, drink potions and perform rituals with the most innovative magic system ever experienced in a fantasy game.
  • Immerse yourself in a Fantasy Role-Playing Masterpiece with real life physics and authentic character interaction with fully digitized speech.
  • Featuring the legendary Ultima System of Virtues where moral fiber is more powerful than physical might. Find out if you have what it takes to be the ultimate hero.
